verdict.rationale: Sentry's own docs say sentry-cli handles 'release and source maps management' and can upload release artifacts, and a dedicated JavaScript 'Uploading Source Maps' doc page exists, so the core CLI upload capability is first-party. The evidence is thin, though: it consists of one summary line and a page title, with no detail on CI workflows or the resulting de-minified stack traces. Missing for 10: any bundler-plugin evidence, a documented CI upload workflow, explicit confirmation that production stack traces resolve to original source, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can upload JavaScript source maps from CI — via CLI or bundler plugin — so production stack traces show my original source, not minified frames

citations.quote: It’s primarily used for managing debug information files for iOS, Android, release and source maps management
It allows you to create, edit and delete releases as well as upload release artifacts for them.
